title: Add high-level gitea-api subcommands and a deletion validator
context: Add high-level append-only subcommands to `gitea-api` and a read-only pull

spec.summary: Add high-level gitea-api subcommands and a deletion validator
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: `pr new` accepts `--repo`, `--title`, and `--body-file`; infers the issue
`status` prints open issues and pull requests for one repository.
All subcommands still use the append-only allowlist; destructive paths
The deletion validator fails when the diff deletes a file and the body
The validator is read-only and runs in CI.
Tests cover the allowlist and the validator.
